name: tg-webui
containerCommand:
apt-get update && apt-get install -y stunnel4 openssl jq && \
     CERT_DIR=/workspace/certs; \
     mkdir -p $CERT_DIR; \
     [[ -f $CERT_DIR/cert.pem ]] || openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 825 \
        -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout $CERT_DIR/key.pem -out $CERT_DIR/cert.pem \
        -subj '/CN=textgen.runpod' -addext 'subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1'; \
     cat > /etc/stunnel/stunnel.conf <<'EOF'
\
foreground = yes
\
pid =
\
[webui]
\
accept = 0.0.0.0:8443
\
connect = 127.0.0.1:7860
\
cert = $CERT_DIR/cert.pem
\
key  = $CERT_DIR/key.pem
\
sslVersion = TLSv1.2
\
EOF
\
     EXTRA_LAUNCH_ARGS='--listen --port 7860 --api --extensions openai --model-dir $MODEL_DIR' /entrypoint.sh & \
     stunnel /etc/stunnel/stunnel.conf
